provenance.notes: md.ref.palette.* and md.sys.color.* (light/dark): SchemeTonalSpot(Hct.fromInt(#6750A4), isDark, contrastLevel 0, specVersion '2021'). Every md.sys.color role aliases the exact reference-palette tone the scheme resolves to. Spec 2021 (the library's default) was chosen over 2025 (M3 Expressive) because it is the colour spec material-web v0_192 implements and it resolves every role to an exact palette tone.

Polyxd additions (M3 only defines error). polyxd.ref.palette.success/warning/info = TonalPalette.fromInt(#2E7D32 / #F9A825 / #0288D1), used with the M3 custom-colour tone pattern (light 40/100/90/30, dark 80/20/30/90). polyxd.ref.palette.chart-1..6 = TonalPalette.fromHueAndChroma(seed hue + 0/240/120/300/180/60 degrees, 48); chart colours use tone 40 (light) / 80 (dark).

md.ref.typeface.*, md.sys.typescale.*, md.sys.shape.*, md.sys.motion.*, md.sys.state.*, md.sys.elevation.*. rem converted to px at 16px/rem. The files sit directly in tokens/versions/v0_192/ (there is no sass/ subfolder at this tag).
Scrim opacity 0.32, disabled content opacity 0.38, icon sizes 18px/24px, outline widths 1px/2px.
Focus ring width 3px, outward offset 2px, colour md.sys.color.secondary. Elevation shadows: key layer (opacity 0.3) and ambient layer (opacity 0.15) per level, transcribed into scripts/generate.ts.
Spacing on the M3 4dp grid (polyxd.ref.space.N = 4N px), size.target.min 48px (M3 minimum target), measure.max 65, and the semantic-tier mapping itself.
